title: CoCoA: Collaborative Chain-of-Agents for Parametric-Retrieved Knowledge Synergy
authors: Yi Jiang; Sendong Zhao; Jianbo Li; Haochun Wang; Lizhe Zhang; Yan Liu; Bing Qin
why_relevant: Proposes a multi-agent framework that explicitly synergizes parametric and retrieved knowledge, addressing the parametric vs retrieved knowledge conflict and mitigating cases where retrieved content misleads generation.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on performance improvement rather than systematic robustness analysis; conflict handling is implicit.
